app_copy.display: Sell to strangers. Get paid safely.
app_copy.lede: Croe holds the buyer's money until they confirm delivery. Nobody has to trust anybody.

job: Name the situation before naming the product. This is a DM sale to someone she has never met, and she is completely relaxed about it.

style.reference: Retro Halftone Editorial Line Illustration v1.0
style.medium: vector illustration emulating screen-print / risograph, flat paper grain, no gradients
style.line_work: heavy hand-inked black outlines 6-10px at 2048px canvas, moderate weight variation (thicker at joints and contact points), confident single-stroke, gently wobbly organic corners, rounded terminals, contours occasionally left open at intersections, minimal interior detail — 1 to 3 crease lines per shape
style.shading: coarse visible round halftone dots, ~45 LPI equivalent, 45 degree angle, ONE flat density per shape, never a gradient ramp
style.values: exactly three readable values — ground, halftone grey, solid black. Midtones are ALWAYS dithered dots, never flat grey.
style.figures: high abstraction, geometric anatomy, exaggerated elongated limbs, oversized hands and feet, mitten-simple fingers, small head relative to body, profile or three-quarter face with ONE curved-line eye, single bold nose and lip contour, no pupils, no nostrils, no ear detail, hair as a solid black graphic mass with a hard silhouette
style.value_separation: every figure reads as a solid-black garment against a halftone garment — two halftone masses must never touch without a black shape between them
style.accent_marks: small abstract ink marks near the head — asterisk/spark, single arcing swoosh, 2-3 short motion dashes. Maximum 2 marks per image.
style.ground_line: one long horizontal ink line anchoring the scene, no drawn floor and no furniture legs
style.composition: flat, no perspective, no horizon, no background scenery, at least 35% empty ground, asymmetric with the weight low
style.text_policy: NO text, letters, numbers or symbols rendered inside the image — the app renders all copy in Plus Jakarta Sans

casting.context: Ghanaian social commerce — sellers trading through WhatsApp and Instagram DMs, mobile money, hand-wrapped parcels
casting.represent: Ghanaian adults, 20s to 40s, everyday sellers and buyers running a business
casting.avoid: tribal-print decoration, huts, drums, wildlife, poverty signifiers, aid imagery, generic 'African' motifs
casting.tone_rule: Calm is the product. No panic, no celebration, no shouting poses. Bodies are relaxed and confident.

scene.subject: a Ghanaian woman with box braids gathered up
scene.pose: seated on the ground, one leg extended and one knee bent, leaning back on one elongated arm, holding a slab phone up at eye level in the other hand
scene.props: a wrapped parcel with taped corners resting on the ground beside her — halftone body, solid black tape cross. The phone is a plain solid black rectangle with no screen content.
scene.accent_marks: a single small asterisk spark floating above the phone
scene.placement: figure low and slightly left, empty ground above her for the headline

prompt: Retro mid-century editorial illustration on a flat #F1F1EF ground. A relaxed Ghanaian woman with box braids gathered up sits on the floor, one leg extended and one knee bent, leaning back on one elongated arm, holding a slab phone up in her other hand at eye level. Her top is solid black, her skirt is halftone dots. A wrapped parcel with taped corners rests on the ground beside her, rendered in halftone with a solid black tape cross. A single small asterisk spark floats above the phone. Bold uneven hand-inked black outlines, flat solid black fills, coarse visible halftone dot shading, strictly three values, no color, no gradients, no soft shadows. Simplified geometric anatomy, exaggerated elongated limbs, oversized hands and feet, profile face with one curved-line eye and a bold minimal nose, solid black graphic hair. Single horizontal ground line. Square 1:1, generous negative space with the figure placed low, screen-print risograph texture. No text anywhere in the image.
negative_prompt: flat grey fills instead of halftone dots
app UI on the phone screen

caption_variant.when: social posts, App Store screenshots, landing page — NOT in-app
caption_variant.caption: sell to strangers.
caption_variant.add_to_prompt: Large lowercase bold Helvetica Neue caption 'sell to strangers.' set flush-left in the upper-left with very tight leading, generous margin from the edge, never overlapping the figure.

qa_checklist: Exactly three values present — no fourth grey
Every midtone is visibly dotted at 100% zoom, dots individually countable
No two halftone masses touch without a black shape between them
Phone screen is empty black, no UI
